results.snippet: # Russian Diesel Tanker Awaits Destination Off US East Coast. A tanker carrying the first cargo of Russian diesel for the United States has come to a halt off the US east coast, shipping data showed on Tuesday, with its operator saying its destination had not yet been decided. President Donald Trump last month announced a surprise deal with Moscow to import diesel from Russia to help lower prices
